intro: Your workspace should work as hard as you do. The T-25 executive table blends thoughtful design with modern aesthetics, creating a clutter-free, inspiring space where ideas flow and productivity thrives.

features.title: A perfect fit for every leader
features.text: From growing professionals to seasoned executives, the T-25 adapts to your needs with widths ranging from 1200mm to 1800mm—because the right workspace fuels the right mindset

features.title: Say goodbye to messy cables
features.text: Tangled wires shouldn’t slow you down. With built-in cable management, an 8M module switch plate, and a soft-closing access flap, your desk stays clean, sleek, and distraction-free.

features.title: Everything you need, within reach
features.text: Designed for seamless organization, the integrated return unit includes a hinged-door storage (HDU) and a drawer—keeping your essentials neatly tucked away but always accessible.

features.title: A finish that speaks your style
features.text: With warm woodgrain and modern neutral tones, the T-25 brings effortless sophistication to your workspace, creating a refined environment that motivates and inspires.

features.title: A step toward a greener future
features.text: Designed with sustainably sourced materials, the T-25 isn’t just good for your office—it’s good for the planet. Thoughtfully crafted to last, because great work deserves a great foundation.

care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
name: Unitized T25 Office Desk
